lines.en: I think Barry is seeing someone in the city.
What would make you think that?
Well, ever since we announced the engagement, he's been acting really weird.
And then last night, he came home smelling like Chanel.
Mindy, if it'll make you feel any better,
when Barry and I first got engaged, he went through a whole weird thing, too.
Oh, God. You see, that's what I was afraid of.
When Barry was engaged to you,
he and I kind of had our little thing on the side.
And when he proposed to me, everyone said,
don't do it, he's just going to do to you what he did to Rachel.
And now I feel so stupid.
Oh, we are both so stupid.
